description: Searches every claim Context Pill has published (the ledger). The query takes 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name: every word must appear somewhere in a claim, so long queries often miss ('claude spreadsheet' works, a full sentence usually returns 0). Returns status at publication, how it was checked, current state (pending, resolved, corrected or closed-inconclusive), the 14-day re-check outcome and any correction. Corrected means a re-check found the claim wrong; the correction says what the source shows now when that could be read. Removed items keep only an id, date and reason, so they don't match. Zero matches says nothing about whether a claim is true. Fits questions about an AI launch, feature, price change, benchmark, leak or rumor, or whether something has shipped. Also fits being asked whether a claim was checked, was verified, held up or turned out to be wrong.

limit.description: Number of claims to return, 1 to 30. Default 10.

query.description: 1 to 3 key words, such as a product or model name, for example 'claude spreadsheet'. Case-insensitive. Every word must appear, so don't pass a full sentence.

name: search_claims
title: Search every published claim
